name: Gemini
summary: The original Gemini is an embedded active-stereo depth and color module for compact machine-vision integration. Its USB 3.0 interface and short working range support smart drones, autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance. This legacy module is distinct from the later Gemini 2 and Gemini 330 cameras.
